description: Provenance ledger for THIRD-PARTY skills pulled from other repos. Every entry records the exact commit reviewed, so update audits are diff-reviews. First-party skills (authored by Amanuel or his agents) live only in index.json. See docs/INTAKE.md for the intake checklist and entry template.

HIGH CONSEQUENCE. Teaches scheduling unattended recurring agent runs with pre-approved permissions (--allowedTools incl. Bash) — removes human oversight from executions. Self-declared risk: critical; includes loop-safety guardrails. Policy: only invoke on explicit user request, never proactively.

Memory is a persistence surface: treat recalled content as untrusted input in later sessions. Near-duplicate 'agent-memory' rejected as redundant.

Doc half-Portuguese, self-contradicts on external APIs.

rejected.reason: Quality, not security: rebadged copy of bitjaru/styleseed 'ss-a11y' still referencing StyleSeed-specific commands and jargon; likely to behave oddly outside that system. Revisit if cleaned up upstream.

Quality, not security: SKILL.md references 4 scripts and 5 reference docs that don't ship, hardcodes the author's Windows paths, and contains an uninvited auto-activation clause. The 8 shipped Python scripts are clean (offline stdlib-only SAST, path-confined, redacting). Revisit if packaging is fixed upstream.

Delegated trust: entire substance is cloning and running an external unvetted repo (fractalmind-ai/agent-manager-skill) that spawns tmux agents on cron. Revisit only after that repo passes its own intake.
Redundant: near-verbatim duplicate of agent-memory-mcp (same upstream webzler/agentMemory, same tool docs). Kept the -mcp variant.

Quality, not security: persona-only content with circular trigger guidance, no procedures, and an instruction to open resources/implementation-playbook.md which does not ship. Topic covered better by ai-agents-architect.

SECURITY FAIL: instructs running scripts/auth.py + gmail.py which do not ship (unreviewable payload); token refresh via undisclosed author-run cloud endpoint mislabeled as 'Google's cloud function'; send/delete with no approval gate. Do not revisit without shipped, reviewable scripts and full disclosure of the refresh endpoint.
SECURITY FAIL: same ghost-scripts + undisclosed token-refresh endpoint pattern as gmail-automation (same author); delete/decline with --no-notify and no approval gate.

SECURITY FAIL: frontmatter 'risk: safe' is false — vendor cloud browser (linkedapi.io) drives the user's live LinkedIn session; DMs/connections/tokens transit vendor servers; can message/post/remove connections with no confirmation; violates LinkedIn ToS (account-restriction risk).

Data custody, not dishonesty: honest wrapper, but all workspace content + OAuth tokens transit Composio's Rube proxy (rube.app). Rejected for executive-data use; revisit if a direct official-connector alternative is needed or Composio is separately vetted and accepted.
Data custody: same Rube/Composio proxy pattern as notion-automation; permanent DELETE_TASK with no confirmation requirement.

Consistency with ui-a11y precedent: written for a foreign system (Antigravity) with tools that don't exist here (ask_user_input_v0), ghost references, and a self-declared review exemption. Method is sound — revisit if ported cleanly.
